# Publication Checklist

Before making a release public:

- [ ] No journal PDFs are present.
- [ ] No screenshots or OCR dumps are present.
- [ ] No real daily outputs contain identifiable personal content.
- [ ] No private-memory files are present.
- [ ] Examples are synthetic.
- [ ] Git history has been checked for accidentally committed secrets or journals.
- [ ] Connector tokens and repository credentials are absent.
- [ ] Safety and non-diagnostic boundaries remain intact.
